quote: It is unlawful for a driver of a vehicle to fail or refuse to comply with any signal of an authorized flagger serving in a traffic control capacity in a clearly marked area of highway construction or maintenance or any other area which has been designated as a temporary traffic control zone.

activation.condition: Driver in clearly marked highway construction or maintenance, or a designated temporary traffic control zone.
